reviews.text: Great place, great people, great service! Would definitely recommend 🥰 …

I honestly can’t say enough good things about Fluffy Paws! I boarded my dog Max with them and from the moment I dropped him off, I felt completely comfortable knowing he was in such good hands. They were so kind, caring, and attentive with him, and it was obvious how much they genuinely love the dogs they look after.

Max had such a great time, and I really appreciated all the updates and care they provided while he was there. It gave me so much peace of mind being able to enjoy my time away knowing he was happy, safe, and being well taken care of.

I would 100% recommend Fluffy Paws to anyone looking for a place to board their dog. They truly go above and beyond, and I’ll definitely be bringing Max back! 🐾🤍

Boarded my dog with them for a week at their previous facility and they waited until I was out of the country to tell me my dog was not a good fit and could no longer stay, despite being very clear about his challenges ahead of time. I was told him and one other dog would be the only dogs in their care at the time, which was far from the truth. Was given one day to find alternate arrangements while being out of the country.

Do not send your dog here if they have any behaviour issues or have challenges with other dogs.
Great daycare spot in the neighbourhood, friendly staff, professionally operated, recommended !

I took my dog for a meet and greet here yesterday and everything was so professionally done. They asked me lots of questions to make sure they knew all her behaviours and that she was comfortable. We loved meeting everyone and will defintely be booking the pup in!

My wife and I were in town for just one day. After our meet and greet our corgi stayed for a half day while we enjoyed the Toronto museums. Fluffy Paws was great. We were so happy with their facility. It all worked out so well.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I had the best experience at Fluffy Paws! I have two dogs, Kaiser and Helga. The team immediately put me at ease with their professionalism, patience, and genuine kindness. They took such great care of both of my dogs, and it was clear they truly care about every pet that comes through their doors.

They were also incredibly supportive and non-judgmental, taking the time to share helpful tips and advice that have made a real difference. I can’t thank the Fluffy Paws team enough for making such a positive experience for both me and my dogs. I highly recommend them!

Our dog went here for the first time and had a great experience. We received videos and photos throughout her daycare visit, and she was a happy girl when we picked her up. The team is very caring and made sure we felt comfortable with our dog’s first visit.

They discount your stay for a 5 star Google review so don’t take the good rating to serious. My dog had a spinal surgery 14 weeks ago and I asked for her to play in small groups or with calmer dogs. They just wouldn’t take my concern seriously. She also came back home severely dehydrated to the point, I had to bring her to the vet and get a hydration shot. My dog is a regular border elsewhere and comes back in great condition. She came back in very rough condition from this place.
Wonderful and caring

We are so incredibly grateful to have found this daycare for our dog, Akira. She struggles with separation anxiety, and the team here has been absolutely amazing in making her feel safe, comfortable, and loved. We truly feel she is in the best hands.

Beyond the excellent care, the facility is always impeccably clean, which gives us even more peace of mind. What we love most is the detailed daily reporting, they update us on her walks, meals, and bathroom breaks, and let us know how she’s doing throughout the day.

Additionally, their flexibility is a lifesaver for us. We often have unpredictable work schedules, and being able to book with short notice is incredibly helpful.

Their hours are also very accommodating to any shift pattern. The staff is always so kind, friendly, and genuinely caring. We cannot recommend them enough!
It's the perfect doggy daycare for my pup! The photos and videos they share are amazing to see and they keep you very updated on their very easy to use portal.

We’ve had a great experience with this daycare! My dog is always excited to go and comes home happy and tired after a fun day of play. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a trustworthy place for their pup!

I have been taking my dog to Fluffy Paws Pet Care for months several times a week. My dog is very happy there, the staff is great (they are all certified trainers). Don't let the minimalistic setup fool you, it's a great place.

The staff are very attentive, professional, and genuinely caring! They really take the time to understand each dog's personality and individual needs, which I appreciated so much. It's clear that the dog’s well-being comes first!

One of my favorite parts was all the updates they sent throughout his stay. I received photos, videos, and messages showing how much fun he was having which gave me so much peace of mind while I was away!

It's not easy to leave your dog with someone else, but this team made it incredibly easy to trust them. My dog came home happy, relaxed, and clearly well cared for. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend them to anyone looking for daycare or boarding services, and we'll definitely be back! :)

Couldn’t recommend Fluffy Paws enough!!! They arranged an initial meet and greet before booking my dog in for boarding to make sure he was comfortable in the environment and to get to know his personality, routine and individual needs - it was very thorough and reassuring.

The facilities are great and the staff were fantastic. While we were away, we received regular updates on his eating, bathroom breaks and walks, along with lots of photos and videos of him having the best time with his new friends!

The location is fantastic, the booking process was easy, reasonable prices and communication was excellent throughout. We always felt like he was in safe hands with a team who genuinely care and are so knowledgeable. Reggie loved his stay and we will definitely be back!

We left our dog Reggie with Fluffy Paws for 3 nights while we were away and had a great experience from start to finish.

The meet and greet was really reassuring and throughout his stay we got plenty of updates, photos and videos which was great to see. Reggie looked like he was having a brilliant time and was getting lots of attention.

When we picked him up he was happy, relaxed and clearly well looked after. He’s also delighted with his new toy!

Thanks again to everyone at Fluffy Paws for taking such good care of him. We’ll definitely be using you again and would happily recommend you to anyone looking for dog boarding.

Such an incredible daycare!! I know when I drop off my husky she’s well looked after by a compassionate and knowledgeable team. She always leaves socially happy and tired. Could not recommend them enough!

I could cry from happiness and relief for having found this place.

My pup has a fair amount of anxiety and the team was so professional and patient with her. Very soon after, she opened up and played all day. They sent numerous updates and videos of her playing, napping, updates on her eating and walks. They even gave me a few training tips where applicable.

Needless to say, she came home so happy and immediately fell asleep, even smiling in her sleep. I cannot wait to bring her back! Thank you so much!!
My little Maltipoo Mayo loves this place! Although he’s an anxious dog, he’s getting used to playing with the other dogs the more he goes. The staff take care of Mayo so well.

Our rescue puppy Cece absolutely LOVES Fluffy Paws! She used to be shy around dogs but has been properly socialized through daycare here and now loooves to play! She’s the most playful puppy and she’s always so happy after her visits here. Peter and the team always take such good care of her, thank you!
Bear loves it here and I’m happy to leaving him for a couple days or boarding! The team is fantastic, lots of updates and photos as well through the website!

My pup Euro is obsessed with this place and honestly so am I. The second we pull up to daycare he’s already losing it trying to get out of the car lol. Special shoutout to Peter and Sophia who  have been amazing and super easy to communicate with and taken such good care of my pup.  I never have to worry about him when he’s there which is huge for me. 10/10 would recommend!

We’re very particular about who looks after our dog, Willie, so finding Fluffy Paws has been a huge relief. Willie is a small breed, so we’re especially cautious about his physical safety around bigger dogs—and it’s clear they take that just as seriously. The team has real expertise in handling dogs, and everything feels thoughtful, well-managed, and calm.

What really sets them apart is the communication. They post regular videos on Instagram and updates on the booking profile, so we can actually see what Willie is up to throughout the day. They also track walks, meals, and even bathroom breaks, which gives us a lot of peace of mind.

Logistically, it’s easy—drop-off and pick-up are smooth, and booking online is straightforward.

Overall, we feel completely secure leaving Willie there, which is not something we say lightly. Five stars.

My little frenchie, Biggie Smalls absolutely loves it here! When he spends the day at Fluffy Paws, he comes home so happy and so sleepy! A safe and convenient solution if you are working or out for the day! Biggie will forever be a loyal pup to Fluffy Paws!

My dog Margo is always so excited to come here, and that says everything 🐶💛
The staff are kind, reliable, and truly care about the dogs.
We also love the daily reports and Instagram updates! It’s the best seeing her having fun while we’re away.
So grateful to have found such an amazing place🪄

Penny has had a great experience so far, staff are friendly and professional, safe & clean environment for dogs to mix. Regular updates and photos are always sent! Would recommend to anyone looking for a place

Great team! They were very caring while my dog was recovering from her spay and wearing a cone. They separate my dog with other dogs for her own good. I feel completely comfortable leaving my dog with them.
The online booking is super convenient, and I really appreciate how they help correct and improve my dog’s behavior.

Fluffy Paws has been an amazing daycare facility for my dog! She loves going there and often makes a lot of friends during her visit there. Fluffy paws has a very accessible location and website with regular updates about your pet’s visit which is appreciate very much. Highly recommended for any pet parent looking for reliable service! ❣️

I can’t say enough wonderful things about Fluffy Paws Pet Care. Having worked in the veterinary industry for over 20 years, I truly understand how important it is to trust the people caring for your pets and this team exceeds every expectation.

From the moment you walk in, it’s clear how much they genuinely love and respect the animals in their care. The staff are attentive, knowledgeable, and incredibly kind, creating a safe and happy environment for every pet.

My dog, Penelope, absolutely adores it there. She loves all the staff and her fellow furry friends so much that she never wants to leave! In fact, I sometimes have to physically carry her out to the car and she’s definitely not a small dog. That alone says everything about how much she enjoys her time there.

If you’re looking for a place where your pet will be treated like family, Fluffy Paws Pet Care is it. I wholeheartedly recommend them!

Thank you to the entire team,

Penelope's mom and Penelope <3

Harley absolutely loves staying at Fluffy Paws! They are fabulous to work with, and super accommodating, and very helpful and responsive times when my trips have been delayed and extended. They provide lots of photos, videos and updates during his stay and I feel so comfortable when Harley is in their care!
Spent a few days over March break in Toronto visiting family. Fluffy Paws was conveniently located. Great staff, friendly and accommodating. Hours were perfect.

Our dog Pipi loves it at fluffy paws! He’s very nervous usually but was made to feel right at home straight away. He’s gained so much confidence playing with the other dogs and made lots of friends 🥰 I feel very comfortable dropping Pipi off at fluffy paws and would highly recommend! …

My Lucy loves going to Fluffy Paws. As soon as we approach she cries in excitement and pulls me to the door. She loves all the trainers and has made so many dog friends.

Lucy is usually the smallest and full of energy. Kamila and her team were great explaining their approach to me and answered my questions. They allowed her to go at her own pace and accustomed to them and the other dogs. They encouraged her play but also allowed for her to snuggle time.

The team is also very accommodating with ensuring her special diet and treats are used due to her allergies. As a result of her allergies, I like the fact the space is always clean and has a humidifier in the winter. I also appreciate getting the online updates on when Lucy ate and her potty breaks. I also get an update when I pick up Lucy which shows how attentive they are to her.

Our dog Auggie has been going to Fluffy Paws for over two months now and loves it! I like how we are provided updates of when Auggie eats and goes on his walks, and receive lots of photos and videos of him playing through the day! The staff is always very friendly and has great communication about how Auggie’s day went.
The service was acceptable, but the scheduling process felt a bit confusing. I had to follow up more than once to confirm my appointment.
I absolutely love fluffy paws, and so does my dachshund MILA. She is usually very shy, but they make her feel so welcome and she has the best time. I highly recommend them.

Such a fantastic place. Big,
Spacious, and clean. And such a friendly and caring staff.
Kamila and her team have been phenomenal! I highly recommend Fluffy Paws daycare, our dog Reggie has absolutely loved it there!

I just moved to Toronto for work and with the whole new job, new apartment… new city, I was really anxious about how I could make sure she was happy. Amazingly, the Liberty Village location opened up very close to my office and she absolutely loves being there! Their staff are professional, truly care about the pups and it shows when you see the dogs and facilities. From an anxious owner with an anxious little dog we highly recommend fluffy paws!🐾🦴🐕❤️😊

This is my dogs safe and happy place. The staff is professional and technically trainers so the dogs have beautifully structured and professional supervised day. Supervised play, rest, walks and fully balance experience. I feel safe to leave my rather shy dog knowing that he will have good time but also place to withdraw if he wants to rest.
The best testament is that he can't wait to get in the door to stay there.  Highly recommend this facility because it is not just a doggy day care but proper training  experience.

I boarded my dog Ocean for the first time here and people were extremely welcoming. Not only that they also corrected Ocean’s behavior and impulse actions. They gave timely updates of his meal, walk and playtime. It was a great experience, will definitely go back!

If I had a chance to put more starts, I would have definitely done it. Brought my ball of energy Lola for her first meet and greet appointment, where Kamila and her team did a fantastic job on meeting us and taking care of my dog. They properly evaluated my dog’s behavior and bad habits that my dog had built over time and they instantly were able to correct it. Moreover, they gave us proper guidance on the next steps on how to approach our dog to correct her behavior.
Long story short, I recommend this place to anyone who needs either a day care for their dog or training. Good and well maintained place led by real professionals.

Kamila took wonderful care of our two pups while we were away! She also accommodated a very last minute change in schedule (due to my own oversight). Our pups didn’t want to come home after their stay!

my dog Blue loves fluffy paws and so do i! Peter and the team are so helpful and run a great facility where dogs can play, learn, and be taken care of properly. As a new dog parent, I feel relieved knowing Blue is in good hands.

HIGHLY RECOMMEND💕💕💕
The staff are very kind and responsive and are amazing with the dogs!! We leave our corgi Barbie here for 3 days at a time and she loves it. They always give us a lil gift after stays and you get updates of your doggy’s which is very comforting.

I’ve been supporting them for around 2 years now and I highly suggest you board your dog with these amazing people 💕💕🐾vs the big franchisee options
Cowboy loves coming here. I can’t walk by the door without being dragged in. The staff are great too lots of updates when I pick him up. Amazing service.

Fluffy Paws Pet Care is absolutely amazing! Easy E (our little pup) loves it there, and as dog parents, we couldn’t be happier or more grateful that we found this place.

From the moment you walk in, you can tell this isn’t just daycare,  it’s a safe, contained, supervised space where dogs are genuinely cared for like family. There’s a trainer on-site who actively monitors, and guides the dogs, and it really shows. They observe each dog closely, support healthy play, and treat every pup as part of their pack.

Easy E is only 12 weeks old, and it means the world to us to have found a place where he can socialize early while also learning good manners in a positive, loving environment. For a high-intelligence, high-energy breed with a very extroverted spirit, Fluffy Paws is the perfect balance of play, learning, and care.

Watching how much attention, intention, and heart goes into what they do gives us total peace of mind. We love our pup deeply, and it’s clear that Fluffy Paws does too.

So incredibly thankful to have found this place. Easy E has already made so many dog friends, and we know he’s in the best hands. Highly, highly recommend!

Peter and co. (I didn't get her name 😅) were extremely accommodating to myself and Melvin. Melvin had a bit if separation anxiety during the meet and greet but thankfully they decided to still take him on. Once I left I was told that he slowly got comfortable and then was very social with the other dogs. I am definitely going back as this will be helpful to my "back to school" year.

My dog absolutely loves coming here and I know he is so well looked after. Kamila and her team are incredible. They provide regular updates, reinforce good habits and are so much more attentive compared to other boarding facilities we’ve been to! Oscar will be back soon 🐾 …

Rowan had the time of his life during his first day at Fluffy Paws!

He is a very high energy dog, so it’s very exciting and convenient to be able to bring him to daycare just around the corner from home so he can blow off some steam and be the social butterfly that he is!

"Huge thanks to Kamila.  and all the staff for taking such wonderful care of my dog Olie at Fluffy Paws Pet Care! She was attentive, caring, and made sure Olie was happy and comfortable the entire time. I loved receiving updates and knowing he was in such safe, loving hands. Highly recommend

As a new resident of Toronto, I was looking for the best boarding place for my little dog. Pixie is a nervous little girl who is very shy and doesn’t really get along with other dogs. But as soon as she arrived at Fluffy Paws Kamila took great care of her. She sends us pictures and texts to let us know that she was doing well. I really appreciate the good service and care that Fluffy Paws offered to my little doggy. I recommend them 100%. 5 stars for me.

When I first got my golden retriever, Milo, as a puppy in 2023, there were days when I had to go to work and drop him off for the day. During that time, it was important for Milo to be in a calm environment where he could still develop, play, and learn. Kamila, the dog trainer, was instrumental in Milo's development during this period.

When I picked him up, he was excited to see me but also calm on our drive home, having expended his energy, which allowed us to return home and smoothly transition into the evening routine without the need for a long walk.

After leaving doggy day care, he became more responsive and engaging with my commands. I believe this time with Kamila helped Milo grow into the wonderful golden retriever he is today.

I highly recommend Kamila and the Fluffy Paws Pet Care team for anyone with a puppy or dog.

I am so happy that I found Fluffy Paws! For the first time ever I feel confident in people who take care of my Musia while I am in a trip. They take care of her, send me pictures and videos of her every day and play with her. Thank you guys, I’ll definitely call you again.
Kamila was great with my dog, Masato. She was able to have him for an overnight stay. Will use and recommend her services to everyone!

My dog has stayed overnight with Kamila a few times now and he loves being there! She takes great care of the dogs and always sends photo and video updates. She is very kind and caring and even sent him home with a new toy :)
I will continue to recommend Kamila to anyone who needs dog care.

I’m so glad I found Daycare at Fluffy Paws for my dog Archi! It’s truly a great place. The staff is super attentive and friendly, always ready to answer any questions and take all my requests into account. Archi practically lights up when I pick him up — it’s clear he enjoys it there and loves interacting with the other dogs.

You can tell they really care about both the physical and mental well-being of the animals. I can leave my pet with peace of mind, knowing he’s in good hands. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a trustworthy place for their furry friend!
I leave my dog every Monday, Tuesday and Friday. Lovely people and my dog is always happy to meet Alex and Kamila!

Peter (1 year old cockapoo) always has a great time when he stays at Fluffy Paws. He has some anxiety issues but Kamila and the team are very good with him. We feel confident knowing he is well taken care of, having lots fun and cuddles while we're away.
Socs has had a great time at Fluffy Paws and always comes home happy and tired!

Our mini cockapoo loves his time with Kamila and the team at FluffyPaws! She was the first sitter we trusted with our puppy and he scrambles to see her whenever we bring him over (he is pretty anxious so this is a big green flag!). The cute …

Kamila took great care of our dog Goose! She had other dogs there and did a great job with introducing Goose so she could be best buds with them. She is clearly knowledgeable and experienced! Highly recommend.
